workstream: W3R-2a — Define shared Place Registry schema
scope: Schema/design record only. Defines the canonical BetterMakati place record, provenance and relationship rules, and the boundary between shared place facts and Civic Map/participation-specific data. No application data is migrated in this step.
nonGoals: Do not move civicAssets out of src/data/civicMap.ts yet.
Do not change Civic Map, BetterBarangay, Mobility, Services, Search, Visit Makati, Heritage, Projects, Accountability or City Monitor behavior.
Do not add new places or reopen completed facility, park or transport reconciliation.
Do not define structured observation questions; that remains W3R-6a.
Do not implement nearby-place matching; that remains W3R-5b.
Do not merge records by fuzzy name or geographic proximity.
designPrinciples: A place has one canonical identity independent of any page or map that consumes it.
Stable existing CivicAsset IDs are preserved when those assets migrate into the registry.
Location, verification state and real-world operating/service lifecycle are separate concepts.
Canonical facts carry explicit provenance; coordinates may have different evidence from names, addresses or lifecycle status.
Aliases describe names for the same identity only. Predecessors, successors and same-corridor facilities remain separate records linked by explicit relationships.

The registry stores durable place facts. Reports, proposals, observations, case lifecycle, submission state and user-generated aggregates reference a place by placeId but are not embedded in the place record.
Access class is a factual property of a place, not a quality score or endorsement.
No generic rating score belongs in the Place Registry.
Unknown or unresolved facts remain unknown; migration must not infer lifecycle, barangay, access or identity from weak signals merely to fill fields.

id.description: Stable slug-like canonical identifier. Existing CivicAsset.id values are preserved during W3R-2b.

name.description: Current canonical public-facing name supported by the best available evidence.

summary.description: Short factual descriptor suitable for reuse across pages. Replaces CivicAsset.subtitle when the text describes the place rather than the Civic Map.

primaryCategory.description: Primary place/asset family. Initial taxonomy is the current CivicAssetType set; future additions require explicit taxonomy revision rather than ad-hoc strings.

secondaryCategories.description: Optional controlled secondary classifications when one place legitimately serves more than one reusable website function.

itemShape.name: string
itemShape.kind: current-alternate | former-name | historical-name | abbreviation | local-name | unclassified

aliases.description: Alternative names for the same place identity. A predecessor or successor is not an alias unless the evidence supports continuous identity.

relationToMakati.description: Whether the physical place lies in Makati, sits on a boundary, is outside Makati but serves Makati, or is a multi-place route/network.

barangays.description: Canonical barangay names. Empty is allowed only when genuinely unknown, outside Makati, or not meaningful for a route/network.

point.description: Point used for map display and distance selection. Non-point assets may use a centroid or representative point without pretending it is exact geometry.

shape.side: north | south | east | west | both | not-applicable | unknown?

geometry.description: Describes spatial form without requiring full GIS geometry in the first registry version. geometryRef may later point to a maintained geometry source.

responsibilityText.description: Human-readable authority/management text preserved from verified current data where normalized body roles are not yet available.

itemShape.name: string
itemShape.role: owner | operator | manager | maintainer | regulator | service-provider | other

management.description: Separates who owns, manages, operates or regulates a place. Migration may preserve responsibilityText first and normalize bodies later without losing evidence.

servicesAtLocation.description: Services physically available at this location. serviceId may later reference a canonical BetterMakati service guide.

shape.class: government-public | public-access-private-managed | private-community-controlled | service-users-only | restricted | unknown

access.description: Who can ordinarily access the place. Preserves the existing three CivicAccessClass values and adds explicit restricted/unknown service-location cases.

shape.status: operating | temporarily-suspended | under-construction | future | closed | unknown

lifecycle.description: Real-world place/service lifecycle. This is never derived from Civic Map mapping status. It carries forward the PNR/NSCR lifecycle design.

verification.description: Editorial/evidence state of the registry record. This is distinct from lifecycle and from map visibility.

provenance.description: Field-aware provenance. Coordinates, current name, access, lifecycle and management can cite different evidence.

itemShape.kind: part-of | contains | same-site-as | predecessor-of | successor-of | service-location-for | served-by | related-project | related-accountability | related-city-monitor | related-heritage
itemShape.targetType: place | service | project | accountability-record | city-monitor-record | heritage-record

relationships.description: Explicit links only. Relationship creation must be evidence-based and must not rely on automated fuzzy matching.

tags.description: Search/discovery descriptors. Tags do not establish identity, lifecycle, access or management facts.

civicMapConsumerBoundary.principle: Civic Map becomes one consumer of the Place Registry. Map-specific presentation and participation behavior must not become canonical place facts.

legacyStatus.description: Temporary compatibility field during W3R-2b so current pages do not change behavior. It must not be interpreted as real-world lifecycle.

defaultLayer.description: Consumer-side layer selection if/when Civic Map needs it. Not part of canonical place identity.

mapVisibility.description: Consumer-side display policy, especially for historical/future/private-access places.

mapLabelOverride.description: Rare UI label override; canonical name remains in the registry.

fieldsExplicitlyNotInRegistry: marker style, color, cluster state or selected state
generic rating/review values or rating aggregates
report counts, proposal counts or popularity counts

participationDataBoundary.rule: Participation entities reference a canonical place through placeId; they do not mutate the canonical record automatically.
protectedBehavior: Emergency handling remains outside the registry.
Duplicate detection remains outside the registry.
Human review before government referral remains outside the registry.
User submissions never rewrite canonical name, address, lifecycle, management or access without an explicit editorial verification step.

currentCivicAssetMigrationMapping.rule: Preserve current verified title unless later evidence explicitly changes the canonical name.
Map one-to-one to the initial controlled taxonomy.
Carry over when factual and reusable; keep Civic-Map-only wording out of the canonical record.
Convert to an array only after validating the actual geography. Do not mechanically split slash-delimited values such as boundary/route descriptions.
Preserve coordinates. Set point.role from evidence and geometry; use representative/centroid for non-point assets rather than claiming exact geometry.
Use for segment descriptors. Do not invent full GIS geometry.
Preserve text first. Normalize bodies/roles only where evidence clearly supports it.
Convert each label to a structured entry. Add serviceId only when a canonical BetterMakati service guide relationship exists.
Preserve existing values exactly; use unknown rather than guessing when absent.
Preserve names but classify historical/former/current-alternate only where provenance supports the distinction.
Create a canonical-fact source and attach it to the fields it actually supports.
Create a separate coordinate source and attach it specifically to location.point/geometry.
Do not map mapped/pilot/needs-verification to lifecycle.status. W3R-2b may keep the legacy value only as a compatibility field.
Preserve current discovery tags; later deduplicate and normalize without changing identity.

integrityRules: Place IDs are unique and stable.
An alias cannot create a second current record for the same verified identity.
A predecessor/successor with distinct identity remains a separate record even if name or geography overlaps.
Legacy PNR and future NSCR facilities remain lifecycle-distinct records; Dela Rosa must not be aliased to future NSCR Buendia.
Lifecycle status must never be inferred from mapped/pilot/needs-verification.
A verified record must have at least one source and at least one assertion supporting its canonical identity/current existence.
Coordinate/geometry claims should cite coordinate or geometry evidence separately when that evidence differs from the identity source.
In-Makati point places should normally resolve to a canonical barangay; boundary, route/network and unresolved cases may use multiple/empty barangays with an explicit note.
Out-of-Makati service locations must use relationToMakati=serves-makati-outside rather than being assigned a Makati barangay.
Public-access private-managed places remain distinguishable from government-public places.
No user-generated report, proposal, observation or case event directly changes canonical place facts.
No generic rating score, ranking or derived popularity metric is stored in the Place Registry.
Cross-dataset relationships are explicit and ID-based; do not mass-create them with fuzzy matching.

w3r2bHandoff.nextStep: W3R-2b — Introduce Place Registry data layer
implementationConstraints: Create the shared data layer using this schema without visible UI changes.
Preserve existing Civic Map behavior through a temporary re-export/adapter if needed.
Migrate current canonical asset facts only; do not add new records from governmentServiceOffices, Visit Makati or other datasets in the same step.
Keep legacy Civic Map status as compatibility data only and keep lifecycle separate.
Do not reopen completed place research.
Stop after data-layer refactor and focused type/build validation.

implementationNotes: W3R-2b adds alias kind 'unclassified' as a migration-safe state so legacy alias strings are preserved without guessing whether they are current, former, historical, abbreviations or local names.

selectors.name: placesByBarangay
selectors.contract: Normalized exact barangay matching with lookup-only support for legacy slash-delimited composite labels; does not rewrite canonical geography.

selectors.name: placesByCategory
selectors.contract: Matches primaryCategory and secondaryCategories after normalized exact comparison.

selectors.name: placesByService
selectors.contract: Matches canonical serviceId when present or normalized service label.

selectors.name: placesByLifecycle
selectors.contract: Exact PlaceLifecycleStatus match; migrated W3R-2b records currently remain unknown unless separately evidenced.

selectors.name: placesWithinDistance
selectors.contract: Returns point-backed places within a maximum great-circle distance in kilometers, ordered nearest first; uses a mean Earth radius and is not route-distance or survey-grade geometry.

nextImplementationStep.title: Specify Report something near me
nextImplementationStep.constraint: Design/specification only. Define the location-first reporting flow and matching behavior before implementation.

behavior: Verified registry places are selected by barangay.
Existing barangay facility contacts enrich matching registry places.
Unmatched facilities remain as fallback cards.
Registry place cards link to canonical place detail pages.
Co-located services are shown from servicesAtLocation.
Verified transport stops and terminals are selected from the shared Place Registry.
MRT-3, EDSA Busway, Pasig River Ferry and One Ayala records remain one canonical dataset shared with Civic Map.
Mobility cards link to canonical place details and registry provenance.
No new transport records or route research were introduced in this step.
Barangay-scoped Services selects verified local service places from the Place Registry.
Government service offices remain a separate dataset and may explicitly reference a canonical placeId.
Service Guide and Government Offices cards link to canonical place details when an explicit placeId exists.
No fuzzy matching, bulk merge or new place research occurs in this workstream.
Service search items carry stable serviceId values.
Saan Ako Lalapit opts into service-place enrichment; other search surfaces do not.
A service resolves a where-to-go office only through an explicit office.placeId relationship.
The result displays the office name and address together with the matched service.
No fuzzy, nearest-place or inferred place matching is used in this step.
Civic Map is one browse surface over canonical place records.
The entry page starts from place discovery and user tasks rather than ratings.
Only verified registry records are listed on the entry page.
Place-detail and reporting mechanics remain unchanged for later W3R steps.
Canonical place facts and provenance come from Place Registry.
The page prioritizes location and sources, existing community cases, then useful actions.
Generic rating entry points and rating criteria are removed from the place-detail experience.
Existing report/proposal/update submission and case lifecycle behavior remain intact.
Legacy review records can still render while structured observations are deferred to W3R-6.
